url: Official KeePassDX documentation (keepassdx.com) and in-app menus
description: Hand-verified capability inventory for KeePassDX (com.kunzisoft.keepass.libre), version 4.4.5.

features.name: Create a database
features.description: Create a database as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: give a name for the database
give a file path/storage location and confirm it with the system file picker
set the master password and/or select a key file
tap the save button to create the .kdbx file

features.name: Open an existing database
features.description: Open an existing database as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: tap "Open existing database"/the file browse icon
select the .kdbx file through the file picker

features.name: Unlock a database with a key file
features.description: Unlock a database with a key file as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: browse to and select the key file
enter the password if the database also uses one

features.name: Unlock a database with a hardware key (challenge-response)
features.description: Unlock a database with a hardware key (challenge-response) as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: present the YubiKey over NFC or connect it by USB when prompted

features.name: Unlock with biometrics or the device credential
features.description: Unlock with biometrics or the device credential as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: unlock the database once with the password and store the credential when prompted
afterwards, present the fingerprint at the unlock screen

features.name: Create an entry
features.description: Create an entry as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: enter the title, username, password and URL

features.name: Generate a password
features.description: Generate a password as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: tap the generate (dice/refresh) icon beside the password field
set the length and the character sets (upper case, lower case, digits, special characters, brackets, extended ASCII)

features.name: Add custom fields to an entry
features.description: Add custom fields to an entry as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: scroll to the custom/extra fields section
enter the field name and value
mark it protected if it should be hidden

features.name: Add an attachment to an entry
features.description: Add an attachment to an entry as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: select the file from the picker

features.name: Download or open an attachment
features.description: Download or open an attachment as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: choose to open it or to download it to a folder

features.name: Set an expiration date on an entry
features.description: Set an expiration date on an entry as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: tap Save; expired entries are marked in the list

features.name: Configure a one-time password (OTP) token for an entry
features.description: Configure a one-time password (OTP) token for an entry as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: choose to scan a QR code, paste an otpauth:// URI or enter the secret manually
set the type (TOTP or HOTP), the algorithm, the digits and the period
tap Save; the rotating code is then shown on the entry screen

features.name: Copy a username or password to the clipboard
features.description: Copy a username or password to the clipboard as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: tap the copy icon beside the username or password field
the value is placed on the clipboard and cleared automatically after the configured timeout

features.name: Reveal a hidden password
features.description: Reveal a hidden password as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: tap the eye icon beside the password field to show it
tap it again to hide it

features.name: Open the entry URL in the browser
features.description: Open the entry URL in the browser as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: tap the URL field/the open-link action
the address opens in the default browser

features.name: Edit an entry
features.description: Edit an entry as documented for KeePassDX.

features.name: View an entry's history
features.description: View an entry's history as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: scroll to the history section (KDBX databases keep previous versions)
tap a historic version to inspect it

features.name: Duplicate an entry
features.description: Duplicate an entry as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: Long-press the entry in the list

features.name: Move an entry to another group
features.description: Move an entry to another group as documented for KeePassDX.

features.name: Delete an entry
features.description: Delete an entry as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: confirm; if the recycle bin is enabled the entry is moved there instead of being erased

features.name: Create a group
features.description: Create a group as documented for KeePassDX.

features.name: Edit, move or delete a group
features.description: Edit, move or delete a group as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: tap Edit to rename it or change its icon and notes, tap the move action to relocate it, or tap Delete and confirm

features.name: Use the recycle bin
features.description: Use the recycle bin as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: Open the database settings and enable the recycle bin
deleted entries and groups are moved into it
open the recycle bin group to restore an item (move it back) or to delete it permanently

features.name: Change an entry or group icon
features.description: Change an entry or group icon as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: Open the entry or group editor
choose a standard KeePass icon or a custom icon added to the database

features.name: Search the database
features.description: Search the database as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: tap the search icon in the toolbar

features.name: Configure search behaviour
features.description: Configure search behaviour as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: choose which fields are searched (title, username, URL, notes, custom fields), whether the search is case sensitive and whether the recycle bin is included

features.name: Sort the entry list
features.description: Sort the entry list as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: choose the field (title, username, creation time, modification time or last access) and the direction

features.name: Use the KeePassDX autofill service
features.description: Use the KeePassDX autofill service as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: return to any app with a login form
pick the matching entry; the fields are filled automatically

features.name: Use the Magikeyboard to type credentials
features.description: Use the Magikeyboard to type credentials as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: enable the Magikeyboard and add it in the Android keyboard settings
open an app with a login form
tap the username and password keys to type them

features.name: Save changes to the database
features.description: Save changes to the database as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: tap the save icon in the toolbar (or enable automatic saving in Settings)
wait for the confirmation that the .kdbx file has been written

features.name: Open a database in read-only mode
features.description: Open a database in read-only mode as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: enable the read-only toggle before unlocking
the database opens without allowing modifications

features.name: Lock the database manually
features.description: Lock the database manually as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: Tap the lock icon in the toolbar (or use the lock action in the notification)
the database is closed and the unlock screen returns

features.name: Configure automatic locking
features.description: Configure automatic locking as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: set the inactivity timeout, whether the database locks when the screen turns off and whether it locks when the app is closed

features.name: Configure clipboard timeout
features.description: Configure clipboard timeout as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: select how long copied values remain on the clipboard before being cleared

features.name: Block screenshots
features.description: Block screenshots as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: enable the "Screenshot prohibited"/secure screen option; the app content is excluded from screenshots and the recents preview

features.name: Change the master key of a database
features.description: Change the master key of a database as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: enter the new password and/or select a new key file

features.name: Change the database encryption settings
features.description: Change the database encryption settings as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: set the encryption algorithm (for example AES or ChaCha20), the key derivation function (AES-KDF or Argon2), the number of iterations, the memory usage and the parallelism

features.name: Edit the database name, description and default username
features.description: Edit the database name, description and default username as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: edit the name, the description, the default username and the database colour

features.name: Configure history and compression settings
features.description: Configure history and compression settings as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: set the maximum number of history items per entry, the maximum history size and whether the database is compressed

features.name: Use entry templates
features.description: Use entry templates as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: Open the database settings and set the templates group (KDBX 4)
choose a template such as email, Wi-Fi, credit card or note

features.name: Merge/synchronise changes from another copy of the database
features.description: Merge/synchronise changes from another copy of the database as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: confirm; the differences are merged into the open database

features.name: Save a copy of the database (Save as)
features.description: Save a copy of the database (Save as) as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: choose the destination file with the system picker

features.name: Add a database to the recent list and pin it
features.description: Add a database to the recent list and pin it as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: Open a database once; it appears on the start screen list
long-press the entry there to remove it, or use the option to keep the file reference for quick reopening

features.name: Change the app theme and appearance
features.description: Change the app theme and appearance as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: choose the theme (light, dark, black or system), the icon pack style, the list density and the text size

features.name: Change the app language
features.description: Change the app language as documented for KeePassDX.

features.name: Configure keyboard and form-filling behaviour
features.description: Configure keyboard and form-filling behaviour as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: toggle the autofill inline suggestions, whether the app asks to save new credentials, and the Magikeyboard behaviour (auto-open, entry selection, notification)

features.name: View the about screen, contribution and licence information
features.description: View the about screen, contribution and licence information as documented for KeePassDX.
actions: read the version, the changelog, the contribution options and the licence
